input.task: What does the greeting page say?

provenance: The other half of ADR-027 Decision 4: a USD ceiling, not only a token one. A frontier model's price is the reason tokens alone stop being the right meter (ADR-010's ceiling is a MODEL, and loop mode is allowed above it), so the runaway guard has to be able to trip on dollars. Mode B's RUN_BUDGETS has no llm_usd key and is unchanged.
